description: English-Amharic code-switched conversational dataset for LLM benchmarking. 2000 multi-turn dialogues covering 15 topics across 3 CS frequency levels and 3 language dominance conditions. Combines 30 original gold dialogues, 970 synthetic template-based dialogues, and 1000 dialogues adapted from four publicly available English conversational corpora. Fully reproducible (RNG seed=42). All generated dialogues follow the EthioSwitch annotation schema for coherence, semantic consistency, switch-point naturalness, fluency, and inter-annotator agreement.
public_dataset_references: Li, J., et al. (2017). DailyDialog. IJCNLP. https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.03957
Zhang, S., et al. (2018). PersonaChat. ACL. https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.07243
Rashkin, H., et al. (2019). EmpatheticDialogues. ACL. https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.00207
Smith, E.M., et al. (2020). BlendedSkillTalk. ACL. https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.08449

annotation_schema.semantic_consistency: 0.0-1.0 (cosine similarity of meaning across switch point)

generation_methods.hand_crafted: Original gold dialogues written by expert annotators.
generation_methods.template_cs: Synthetic dialogues generated from English templates with CS insertion.
generation_methods.public_adaptation: Dialogues adapted from public English corpora with CS applied.
